build_tensorpipe_extension: build the pytensorpipe C++ extension module using cmake and clang-6.0 compilers
run_cmake_build: run the CMakeBuild class to compile the tensorpipe Python extension via setuptools build_ext
configure_cmake_with_env_vars: configure cmake to pass all TP_ environment variables as CMake definition flags
review_CMakeBuild_class: review the CMakeBuild class that extends setuptools build_ext to use cmake for building
summarize_setup_call: summarize the setuptools setup call that registers the tensorpipe package and pytensorpipe extension
